title: "Snakebite-Holoruminant-MetaG"
subtitle: "Module report: reads"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y')`"
geometry: margin=2cm
fontsize: 10pt
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("reads")

samples <- ctx$samples
members <- assembly_members()

fastqc_files <- crossing(library = libraries(), end = 1:2) %>%
  arrange(match(library, libraries()), end) %>%
  mutate(
    file = paste0(library, "_", end),
    zip = p("results", "reads", paste0(file, "_fastqc.zip")),
    raw = ifelse(end == 1, samples$forward_filename[match(library, samples$library)],
                 samples$reverse_filename[match(library, samples$library)]),
    raw_bytes = file.info(p(raw))$size
  )
have <- filter(fastqc_files, file.exists(zip))
qc <- setNames(map(have$zip, read_fastqc), have$file)
per_file <- map_dfr(names(qc), ~ mutate(fastqc_summary(qc[[.x]]), file = .x))
if (nrow(per_file) > 0) per_file <- left_join(have, per_file, by = "file")
per_library <- if (nrow(per_file) > 0) {
  per_file %>%
    group_by(library) %>%
    summarise(
      read_pairs = reads[end == 1][1],
      reads_r2 = reads[end == 2][1],
      bases = sum(bases),
      read_length = paste(unique(read_length), collapse = ", "),
      gc_pct = mean(gc_pct),
      mean_quality = mean(mean_quality),
      reads_q30_pct = mean(reads_q30_pct),
      deduplicated_pct = mean(deduplicated_pct),
      max_adapter_pct = max(max_adapter_pct),
      raw_bytes = sum(raw_bytes),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(library, libraries())) %>%
    mutate(sample = samples$sample_id[match(library, samples$library)])
} else {
  tibble()
}
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  para(
    "The sample sheet `", sample_file, "` lists **", n_distinct(samples$sample_id), " samples** with **",
    nrow(samples), " libraries**, which go into **", length(ctx$assemblies), " assemblies**."
  )
  if (nrow(per_library) > 0) {
    para(
      "Sequencing produced **", fmt_int(sum(per_library$read_pairs)), " read pairs** (",
      fmt_bp(sum(per_library$bases)), "), on average ", fmt_int(mean(per_library$read_pairs)), " pairs per library (",
      "range ", fmt_int(min(per_library$read_pairs)), " to ", fmt_int(max(per_library$read_pairs)), ", median ",
      fmt_int(median(per_library$read_pairs)), "). Reads are ", paste(unique(per_library$read_length), collapse = " and "),
      " bp long, with a mean GC content of ", fmt_pct(mean(per_library$gc_pct)), ", and a mean read quality of Q",
      fmt_num(mean(per_library$mean_quality)), "; ", fmt_pct(mean(per_library$reads_q30_pct)),
      " of the reads have a mean quality of at least Q30."
    )
    low <- filter(per_library, read_pairs < 0.5 * median(read_pairs))
    mismatch <- filter(per_library, read_pairs != reads_r2)
    bullets(c(
      if (nrow(low) > 0) {
        paste0("**Low depth:** ", paste0("`", low$library, "`", collapse = ", "), " has less than half of the median number of read pairs.")
      } else {
        "No library has less than half of the median number of read pairs."
      },
      if (nrow(mismatch) > 0) {
        paste0("**Broken pairs:** the two files of ", paste0("`", mismatch$library, "`", collapse = ", "),
               " have different numbers of reads. Check these files before going on.")
      } else {
        "In all libraries, the forward and reverse files have the same number of reads."
      }
    ))
  } else {
    no_output("FastQC", "results/reads/")
  }
})
```

```{r design}
section("Study design", {
  para("A **sample** is one biological sample. A **library** is one sequencing library of it, and a sample can have several. ",
       "An **assembly** is made from the libraries assigned to it, so one that uses many libraries is a co-assembly.")
  design <- samples %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    summarise(libraries = n(), assemblies = paste(unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(assembly_ids, ",")))), collapse = ", "),
              .groups = "drop")
  show_table(
    design %>% transmute(Sample = sample_id, Libraries = fmt_int(libraries), Assemblies = assemblies),
    "Samples, their libraries and assemblies",
    "samples",
    export = design,
    max_rows = 40
  )
  per_assembly <- members %>%
    group_by(assembly_id) %>%
    summarise(libraries = n(), members = paste(library, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
  show_table(
    per_assembly %>% transmute(Assembly = assembly_id, Libraries = fmt_int(libraries), Members = members),
    "Assemblies and the libraries they use",
    "assemblies",
    export = per_assembly,
    max_rows = 40
  )
})
```

```{r read-counts}
section("Reads per library", {
  if (nrow(per_library) == 0) {
    no_output("FastQC", "results/reads/")
  } else {
    show_table(
      per_library %>% transmute(
        Library = library,
        `Read pairs` = fmt_int(read_pairs),
        Bases = fmt_bp(bases),
        `Length (bp)` = read_length,
        `GC` = fmt_pct(gc_pct, 0),
        `Mean Q` = fmt_num(mean_quality),
        `Reads >= Q30` = fmt_pct(reads_q30_pct),
        Unique = fmt_pct(deduplicated_pct),
        `Adapter max.` = fmt_pct(max_adapter_pct, 2),
        `Files` = fmt_bytes(raw_bytes)
      ),
      "Sequencing output per library, from FastQC. Mean Q is the mean of the mean quality of reads; Reads >= Q30 counts reads with a mean quality of at least 30; Unique is FastQC's estimate of the reads left after removing duplicates; Adapter max. is the highest share of adapter at any read position",
      "reads_per_library",
      export = per_library,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    write_tsv(select(per_file, -zip), file.path(ctx$tables, "fastqc_per_file.tsv"), na = "")
    n <- nrow(per_library)
    show_figure(
      per_library %>%
        mutate(library = factor(library, levels = rev(library))) %>%
        ggplot(aes(read_pairs / 1e6, library)) +
        geom_col(fill = PALETTE[[1]]) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = median(per_library$read_pairs) / 1e6, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
        labs(x = "Read pairs (million)", y = NULL) +
        theme_report() +
        library_axis(n),
      "reads_per_library",
      "Read pairs per library. The dashed line is the median.",
      height = rows_height(n)
    )
  }
})
```

```{r quality}
section("Read quality", {
  if (length(qc) == 0) {
    no_output("FastQC", "results/reads/")
  } else {
    status <- map_dfr(names(qc), ~ mutate(qc[[.x]]$status, file = .x))
    status$file <- factor(status$file, levels = rev(names(qc)))
    para("FastQC gives every file a result for each of its checks. The full reports are in `results/reads/*_fastqc.html`.")
    show_figure(
      fastqc_status_plot(status),
      "fastqc_status",
      "Results of FastQC's checks for each read file.",
      height = rows_height(length(qc), 0.17, 2.2)
    )
    counts <- status %>%
      count(module, status) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
    for (col in c("pass", "warn", "fail")) if (!col %in% names(counts)) counts[[col]] <- 0L
    counts <- counts[match(unique(status$module), counts$module), c("module", "pass", "warn", "fail")]
    show_table(
      counts %>% transmute(Check = module, Pass = pass, Warn = warn, Fail = fail),
      paste0("Number of files per result of each FastQC check (", length(qc), " files)"),
      "fastqc_status_counts",
      export = counts
    )
    write_tsv(status, file.path(ctx$tables, "fastqc_status.tsv"))
    fastqc_notes()

    position <- function(x) map_dbl(strsplit(x, "-"), ~ mean(as.numeric(.x)))
    curves <- map_dfr(names(qc), function(name) {
      table <- qc[[name]]$per_base
      tibble(file = name, position = position(table$Base), mean_quality = as.numeric(table$Mean),
             read = ifelse(grepl("_1$", name), "Forward reads", "Reverse reads"))
    })
    write_tsv(curves, file.path(ctx$tables, "quality_per_position.tsv"))
    show_figure(
      ggplot(curves, aes(position, mean_quality, group = file)) +
        annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 30, ymax = Inf, fill = "#009E73", alpha = 0.08) +
        geom_line(colour = PALETTE[[1]], alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
        facet_wrap(~read) +
        labs(x = "Position in read (bp)", y = "Mean base quality (Phred)") +
        theme_report(),
      "quality_per_position",
      "Mean base quality along the reads, one line per file. The shaded area is Q30 and above."
    )

    per_sequence <- map_dfr(names(qc), function(name) {
      table <- qc[[name]]$per_sequence
      counts <- as.numeric(table$Count)
      tibble(file = name, quality = as.numeric(table$Quality), share = 100 * counts / sum(counts))
    })
    gc_curves <- map_dfr(names(qc), function(name) {
      table <- qc[[name]]$gc
      counts <- as.numeric(table[["Count"]])
      tibble(file = name, gc = as.numeric(table[["GC Content"]]), share = 100 * counts / sum(counts))
    })
    write_tsv(per_sequence, file.path(ctx$tables, "quality_per_read.tsv"))
    write_tsv(gc_curves, file.path(ctx$tables, "gc_per_read.tsv"))
    show_figure(
      ggplot(per_sequence, aes(quality, share, group = file)) +
        geom_line(colour = PALETTE[[1]], alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
        labs(x = "Mean quality of a read (Phred)", y = "Reads (%)") +
        theme_report(),
      "quality_per_read",
      "Distribution of the mean read quality, one line per file.",
      height = 2.8
    )
    show_figure(
      ggplot(gc_curves, aes(gc, share, group = file)) +
        geom_line(colour = PALETTE[[3]], alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
        labs(x = "GC content of a read (%)", y = "Reads (%)") +
        theme_report(),
      "gc_per_read",
      "Distribution of the GC content of reads, one line per file. Peaks that differ between samples point to a different community, or to a contaminant.",
      height = 2.8
    )

    adapters <- map_dfr(names(qc), function(name) {
      table <- qc[[name]]$adapter
      if (is.null(table)) return(NULL)
      values <- as.matrix(mutate(table[, -1], across(everything(), as.numeric)))
      tibble(file = name, position = position(table$Position), adapter_pct = apply(values, 1, max))
    })
    if (nrow(adapters) > 0) {
      write_tsv(adapters, file.path(ctx$tables, "adapter_per_position.tsv"))
      show_figure(
        ggplot(adapters, aes(position, adapter_pct, group = file)) +
          geom_line(colour = PALETTE[[6]], alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
          labs(x = "Position in read (bp)", y = "Reads with adapter (%)") +
          theme_report(),
        "adapter_per_position",
        "Share of reads with adapter sequence up to each position, for the most frequent adapter of each file.",
        height = 2.8
      )
    }

    over <- map_dfr(names(qc), function(name) {
      table <- qc[[name]]$overrepresented
      if (is.null(table)) return(NULL)
      mutate(table, file = name, Percentage = as.numeric(Percentage), Count = as.numeric(Count))
    })
    if (nrow(over) > 0) {
      top <- over %>%
        group_by(Sequence, source = `Possible Source`) %>%
        summarise(files = n(), max_pct = max(Percentage), .groups = "drop") %>%
        arrange(desc(max_pct))
      show_table(
        top %>% transmute(Sequence = substr(Sequence, 1, 50), Source = source, Files = fmt_int(files), `Highest share` = fmt_pct(max_pct, 2)),
        "Overrepresented sequences, from all files",
        "overrepresented_sequences",
        export = top,
        max_rows = 15
      )
    } else {
      para("FastQC found no overrepresented sequences.")
    }
  }
})
```
